verdict.rationale: Nix is a package manager and build system, so official SDKs or programmatic libraries are a fair question to ask, but nothing in the evidence documents one. The pack only shows the official CLI (nix build, nix develop, nix repl), which belongs to a separate story and earns no credit here. The OpenAPI and llms.txt probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
